title: B2B service policies
scope: France B2B retail demo: 26 independent regional account scenarios; policy thresholds to be approved by BIC.

rules.title: Applicable policy
rules.requirement: Use the dated, approved policy version applicable to the scope. Unknown or expired rules require clarification.

rules.title: Protect the donor warehouse
rules.requirement: Do not reuse another customer reservation or consume safety stock. Transfer only the same SKU.

rules.title: Respect shipping multiples
rules.requirement: A transfer must be positive and respect the SKU shipping multiple.

rules.title: Protect service dates
rules.requirement: Arrive before the relevant demand date. Separate the firm customer promise from forecast demand. A residual firm shortfall requires commercial review.

rules.title: Protect margin
rules.requirement: Gross margin after incremental freight must be at least 25% of the net value of the option. A lower risk score does not override this check.

rules.title: Apply cost delegation
rules.requirement: Every cost needs human approval: up to EUR 500 Operations; above EUR 500 Supply chain manager; above EUR 1500 Supply chain director and Finance. Unknown costs must be quoted first.

rules.title: Confirm factory acceleration
rules.requirement: Do not commit an acceleration until capacity, date and transport have been confirmed.

rules.title: Obtain distributor agreement
rules.requirement: Split delivery or a changed promise requires documented customer consent. No automatic customer message.
